title: fagara riedeliana
intro: Fagara riedeliana, commonly known as Java citron or Szechuan pepper tree, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. It is a small tree or shrub native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. The health benefits of Fagara riedeliana include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea and vomiting, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, coumarins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties.
